jobs.description: À propos d’Exotec Nous concevons et déployons des solutions d'automatisation d'entrepôt logistique, associant robotique, logiciels et expertise opérationnelle. En tant que fabricant et intégrateur de référence, nous accompagnons certaines des marques les plus emblématiques au monde dans leur transition vers l'automatisation. Nous sommes fiers de concevoir des technologies qui ne se contentent pas de transformer l'intralogistique : elles rendent également les entrepôts plus sûrs, plus performants et moins éprouvants pour les personnes qui y travaillent. Votre rôle Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Tech Talent Acquisition Partner en CDD de 12 mois pour renforcer notre équipe Talent Acquisition. Vous interviendrez sur un périmètre stratégique couvrant les métiers R&D, Product et IT , avec des recrutements majoritairement basés en France. Véritable partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, vous les accompagnerez dans l'identification, l'attraction et le recrutement des talents qui contribuent à concevoir et développer nos solutions robotiques et logicielles dédiées à l'automatisation des entrepôts et à l'optimisation des flux logistiques. Dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, vous prendrez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, de la définition du besoin jusqu'à l'intégration des candidats. Votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance avec les managers, à identifier les bons profils et à faire avancer les processus de recrutement sera essentielle pour réussir dans ce rôle. Basé(e) à Lille, vous serez rattaché(e) au Talent Acquisition Manager et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes RH et les autres membres de l'équipe Talent Acquisition, dans un environnement international. Vos missions Piloter les processus de recrutement de bout en bout sur votre périmètre R&D, Product et IT, de la prise de brief avec les managers jusqu'à la gestion des offres et l'intégration des candidats. jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. jobs.title: Workplace and People Operations Manager
jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. mission As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in.
